title: Duplicated to/cc visibility construction in Create activity
description: src/posting.rs:1317-1340, src/delivery.rs:477-491. The visibility-to-addressing (to/cc) mapping logic is duplicated between create_status and create_scheduled_post. Both map 'public'/'unlisted'/'private'/'direct' to the same to/cc arrays. A shared function visibility_addressing(visibility, followers_url) -> (Vec<Value>, Vec<Value>) would consolidate this.
